lines.text: In this lesson, you will learn to change a variable each time round a loop to make patterns that grow, like spirals, and to count.
Set it to 10 before the loop, then change it by 10 inside the loop.
Each time round, the sprite moves further.
Moving a little further after every turn makes a spiral.
Try different turn angles: 90 makes a square spiral, 120 a triangle spiral, 89 a twisted one!
Set a variable to 1, say it, then change it by 1 — again and again.
To use a variable inside a block, put the orange variable reporter into the white slot.
In the Code Lab, tap the small ▾ next to the number and pick your variable.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now build along, then try the challenges. You’ve got this!
